13.description:
SIDE-lv-conservation: the compiled surround of the conservation clause — the SIDE programme's frontier, machine-checked.

WHAT THIS IS. A Lean 4 kernel (against Mathlib) that compiles the structure surrounding the SIDE proof's one named input: the conservation clause of A Place To Stand (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19675355), Section 27.3 — every zero of xi forces the Euler balance, equivalently the two-channel Li positivity lambda_Z(n) >= -lambda_A(n). Rather than leaving that clause as prose, this kernel fixes it as one compiled goal state and machine-checks everything provable around it: what is established, what is certified in finite range, what is bracketed as false, and exactly where the open mathematics begins.

WHAT IT CONTAINS. h1_complete_at_Phi — all eight per-class coupling facts of the manuscript's Chapter 15, machine-checked at the fixed Mellin witness Phi and conjoined (the catalogue side complete at the witness). The register pentagon — the clause's five equivalent faces (universality, conservation, totality, positivity, spectral distance) compiled as a graded structure, deliberately without compiling the cross-register equivalences, which would be compiling RH-equivalence itself. The finite-range positivity certificate — lambda_n >= 0 proved for n up to the Voros detection threshold (about 2T^2 from zeros verified to height T), with the on-line term's nonnegativity proved in general. Growth bounds for the completed zeta and completed Dirichlet L-functions. Two machine-checked negative results bracketing retired stronger claims. And at this version, the finite-set conjunct of the explicit-formula premise is proved rather than assumed: the nontrivial zeta zeros to height T form a genuine finite set (lowFinset constructed via an entire carrier and analytic isolation of zeros; lowFinset_mem_iff).

HOW TO CHECK. lake build at pinned commit 93c27ec (tag v0.10.0); #print axioms at the named terminals — all report {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}, zero custom axioms; one `sorry`, at T3_perClass_to_combinations, a statement false as stated whose negation the kernel proves (ERRATA E-2026-10-29-1). The one deliberately open obligation is the clause itself; the kernel's docstrings and the manuscript's Sections 25.8 and 27.3 state its exact location and status.

WHAT THIS RECORD IS FOR. It makes the proof's frontier auditable: a reader can see, in compiled form, that the catalogue side is complete, that positivity holds on-line and in the certified range, where the all-n tail begins, and which classical ingredients (Guinand–Weil decomposition, the Voros tail bound) are named as inputs pending Mathlib formalization. The clause is research in progress, mapped in the companion census Paths to the Critical Line.

THIS VERSION. v0.10.0 adds the proved finite-set conjunct (previously an assumed clause of the explicit-formula interface) — a purely additive change; every previously deposited terminal is byte-identical with its axiom profile unmoved.

14.description:
HISTORICAL RECORD. This version is superseded by v1.1.2 (10.5281/zenodo.21539167), which states the result as a reduction of the Riemann Hypothesis to the single located clause h2, named open. The title and the description below are as deposited on 2026-05-01: their claim of a proof is not supported, and the Riemann Hypothesis stays open.

## Main theorem

The Riemann Hypothesis: every nontrivial zero of the Riemann zeta function has real part 1/2.

## Method

The SIDE Exclusion Principle — Symmetry, Independence, Determination, Exhaustiveness. Applied to zeta, it proves that no off-line zero exists by enumerating the catalogue of mechanism classes from which off-line zeros would have to arise and excluding each one.

The seven mechanism classes are proven exhaustive via Ostrowski's classification and the structure of ξ(s). No class produces the algebraic signature of an off-line zero. Independence of the constraints forbids conspiracy among them. Symmetry forces σ = 1/2 as the third identity element.

The result follows without new axioms: the proof operates entirely within ZFC, and every component theorem is classical (Ostrowski 1916, Tate 1950, Størmer 1897, Artin–Whaples 1945, Cartan B 1876/1951).

## Both legs complete

The proof exists as a human-readable mathematical argument in the monograph (Parts I–IV, each chapter ZFC-valid with classical component theorems) and as a machine-verified Lean 4 kernel that compiles the same conclusion end-to-end via three independent routes. A reader who does not read Lean can verify the argument mathematically; a skeptic who does not trust informal proof can run `lake build` and check that the kernel confirms.

## Contents

**Monograph**

- `A_Place_to_Stand.md` — the full 28-chapter manuscript presenting the proof, its architecture, and its context.

**Six companion papers**

- `Exhaustive_Enumeration.md` — the mechanism class enumeration
- `Which_Structure_Confines.md` — structural confinement argument
- `Spectral_Inertness.md` — spectral inertness at σ = 1/2
- `Third_Identity_Element.md` — Trivium and identity structure
- `Silence_of_Foundations.md` — the Silence Principle
- `Seven_Mechanism_Classes.md` — the seven-class exhaustion proof

**Summary**

- `ONE_PAGE_PROOF.md` — condensed statement of the proof chain.

## Paired deposit

This manuscript corpus pairs with the SIDE-kernel v1.1 Lean 4 formalization at DOI [10.5281/zenodo.19937590](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19937590) (superseding v1.0 at [10.5281/zenodo.19674313](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19674313)).
The kernel verifies the proof end-to-end across 83 active Lean files (Kernel + Bridge + MetaKernel) with zero sorry and zero custom axioms, compiled against Mathlib.

Two Mathlib contributions from this work have been merged: PR [#36881](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36881) (`tendsto_mul_logDeriv_simple_zero`) and PR [#36865](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36865) (`analyticOrderAt_eq_one_of_zero_deriv_ne_zero`).

v1.0.1 (April 2026): Orienting paragraph ("How This Monograph Is Organized"), completable-path matrix (§25.5a), CrossClassExclusion surfaced in §25.5 Bridge table. No mathematical changes. Formal verification count unchanged (560 declarations, 0 sorry, 0 axioms).

v1.0.2 (May 2026): Updated paired-deposit cross-reference to SIDE-kernel v1.1 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19937590), which adds Bridge/CartanBBridge.lean elevating n₃ = 2 from manuscript claim to Lean-verified theorem and realigns the kernel with current Mathlib API. Manuscript version stamp bumped from v5.3 to v5.4. No mathematical changes. Companion papers and visualization assets carried forward unchanged from v1.0.1.

16.description:
T₇ Matched-Arc CMB Search — a pre-registered test of a Fano-plane cosmic topology, executed once on Planck 2018.

THE PREDICTION AND ITS REGISTRATION. If the spatial topology of the universe is 𝕋₇ — the Klein surface with seven Möbius strips on the Fano frame PG(2,𝔽₂), first homology H₁ = ℤ ⊕ (ℤ/2)³ — the CMB carries seven matched arc pairs at Fano-specific angular separations, with a Stokes-U polarization sign flip under the non-orientable identification (the discriminator no orientable topology produces). The search was pre-registered in May 2026 — predictions, method, parameters, and a four-threshold decision table frozen before archive access, so the analysis is confirmatory: Nside 64, 1000 Monte-Carlo trials, δθ = 1°, Monte-Carlo seed 770411. The frozen preregistration is included in this record verbatim.

A PRE-SIGNAL GEOMETRY FINDING, STATED FIRST. The seven distinct angular scales are determined by the geodesic distances between identified points in the Fano geometry — but the Fano collineation group GL(3,𝔽₂) (order 168) is transitive on points and on lines, so any realization from the abstract incidence structure alone is provably (near-)degenerate: the seven scales collapse within the search resolution. Seven distinct scales require the physical fundamental domain's generator lengths, which no document of the programme states. A blind derivation attempt from the substrate's own constants (the 1/16 resolution floor, the formation tuple (2,3,2,0), the H₁ free/torsion split) — screened at the rule that a construction must FORCE the ratios, not merely permit them — found that every substrate-native construction yields at most a three-fold partition or a single overall scale, never seven distinct; the one route to seven-distinct (a Hamming-weight split) is basis-dependent and fails the screen. The seven-distinct-scale count discriminator is therefore recorded as UNTESTED-AS-UNDERDETERMINED — the substrate does not determine the seven lengths — closed by survey at that honest boundary.

THE REGISTERED RUN. What the frozen run therefore tested is the registered surviving signature: matched arc pairs with the Stokes-U sign flip — the non-orientability discriminator, scale-independent, unique to 𝕋₇ among the competing topologies — at the common Fano scale, over the frozen θ_min scan (5.0°–90.0°, step 0.5°). It was executed once, as registered, on Planck 2018 SMICA with the UT78-successor common intensity mask, seed 770411.

RESULT. Best θ_min = 54.0°; the matched-arc-plus-polarization statistic is ~0 in absolute terms; the global look-elsewhere-corrected p-value is 0.046. Under the registration's own §5 decision table this is the "Marginal" band (0.01 ≤ p < 0.05), whose committed action is "Publish null; flag for higher-resolution follow-up" (§6 Outcome D). It is not a detection and not suggestive. The 54.0° marginal is null-consistent: 45 of the 1000 random-rotation nulls matched or exceeded the real-sky maximum over the 171-point scan — a 4.6% look-elsewhere false-alarm rate, the fluctuation expected under the null and within the residual foreground / integrated-Sachs-Wolfe modulation the registration itself flags. Direction-scoped, this neither confirms nor falsifies 𝕋₇ at Planck-2018 sensitivity on the surviving signature; the primary seven-scale signature was not tested (underdetermined, above). Per §6, the SIDE methodology is not falsified — only the specific topology proposal is unsupported-at-marginal at this sensitivity; the constellation's other predictions (Ω_b = 4/81; the 77/4 dark-visible decomposition) are independent and unaffected.

WHY THIS PUBLISHES. The registration committed, in advance, to publishing every outcome — detection, suggestive, marginal, or null — as a first-class result (§9, out-of-sample defenses). A marginal-null is a result, not a filing-drawer casualty; it is published here for that reason.

PROVENANCE. Pipeline: SIDE-t7-topology-cmb, registration-conformed run tag v0.3 = 8eb0d5a (t7_arc_search.py; seed 770411); prediction kernel main 936cd65 (Basic.lean §12.1 records the seven-scale route CLOSED BY SURVEY). Environment (registration §8): healpy 1.19.0 / NumPy 2.5.1 / SciPy 1.18.0. Data: Planck 2018 SMICA COM_CMB_IQU-smica_2048_R3.00_full.fits (MD5 ee2fc49a…) + common Int mask (MD5 b607003f…; 77.9% sky ≈ UT78). Result: t7_results.json (MD5 a340fabf…). Full intake, mask-successor ruling, and both pre-signal amendments are in RUN_PROVENANCE.md. Companion (the SIDE reduction of the Riemann Hypothesis to a single located clause, pure mathematics): A Place To Stand, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19675355 — the T₇ cosmology is Phase-2 speculative physics, explicitly not load-bearing for the Riemann Hypothesis.

CONTENTS. T7_CMB_PIPELINE_PREREGISTRATION_v0_1.md (frozen registration, verbatim); T7_CMB.md (the paper, with the executed-search section and the honest-boundary finding); RUN_PROVENANCE.md; t7_results.json (the run output); PIPELINE_POINTER.md (pointer to the GitHub pipeline + prediction kernel).

17.description:
THE OBJECT. The Riemann Hypothesis — every nontrivial zero of the Riemann zeta function has real part 1/2 — reduced to a single located clause, h2, under a machine-verified composition; h2 is named open at Section 27.3.

METHOD. The SIDE Exclusion Principle — Symmetry, Independence, Determination, Exhaustiveness. Applied to zeta, it organizes the exclusion of an off-line zero by enumerating the catalogue of mechanism classes from which one would have to arise and excluding each under the named premise h2. The seven mechanism classes are proven exhaustive via Ostrowski's classification and the structure of ξ(s); no class produces the algebraic signature of an off-line zero; independence of the constraints forbids conspiracy among them; symmetry forces σ = 1/2 as the third identity element. The proof operates entirely within ZFC, and every component theorem is classical (Ostrowski 1916, Tate 1950, Størmer 1897, Artin–Whaples 1945, Cartan 1876/1951).

THE ARGUMENT IN TWO FORMS. The argument exists as a human-readable mathematical monograph and as a machine-verified Lean 4 kernel: the manuscript carries the mathematics; the kernel compiles the logical architecture through three routes under the named premise and reports its axiom base at named theorems. A skeptic can run lake build at the pinned kernel commit (SIDE-kernel v1.5 = 0e5233f) and #print axioms at the named route theorems (structural_exhaustiveness_proved; SpectralCannonFull.spectral_cannon; ConservationBridge.riemann_hypothesis — the third is the compiled implication from ConservationHypothesis, which the kernel's own balance_theorem shows is RH restated, E-2026-09-25-1). All route terminals report {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}. Verification claims are made by named theorem at pinned public commits, never by file counts; the standing correction record is the enclosed ERRATA.md.

WHAT THE MANUSCRIPT ESTABLISHES, AND WHAT IT NAMES AS OPEN. Proved and machine-checked around the argument: the Lean terminal structural_exhaustiveness_proved, which proves that the kernel's mechanism type has seven members, that none of them produces the off-line signature the kernel defines, and Ostrowski's classification of the places of ℚ, with the exhaustiveness of the seven classes over the mechanisms carried as the manuscript's theorem; five compiled identifications of σ = 1/2 in five machineries, three of which share one map under three names, as the programme's statement-read records; Conservation of Spectra from Tate's thesis (Chapter 13); the Mechanism Theorem derived from the Independence, Determination and Symmetry principles (Chapter 10); h1 complete at the witness (h1_complete_at_Phi, SIDE-lv-conservation); the finite-range Li positivity certificate whose finite-set conjunct is itself proved (lowFinset_mem_iff, v0.10.0); and the step (9) assembly stated in its two-sentence form — the identity reading separated from the sign reading. Section 27.3, "The One Premise," names that clause in five equivalent registers with its full literature ancestry (Li 1997; Bombieri–Lagarias 1999; Oesterlé; Voros 2006; Lagarias 2007) and locates it at one goal state, whose terminal in the deposit's concordance (conservation_s_dark, v1.5) is a stand-in for the clause; the C₅-output (Hilbert–Pólya) register is explicitly disclaimed, never claimed. Li's criterion is compiled over Mathlib's zeros as a two-way equivalence in the programme's kernel (li_nonneg_iff_rh, v0.9), its converse vendored from nicholasbulka/li-criterion-rh-equivalence-lean at 35df682f under Apache 2.0; equivalently, RH is the nonnegativity of the Bombieri–Lagarias arithmetic limits (arith_limit_nonneg_iff_rh). Weil positivity on classK, Li positivity and arithmetic-limit positivity are compiled as equivalent faces of the one open clause. The criterion for primitive χ is composed: Weil positivity on classK for χ ⟺ GRH_chi, both directions compiled (h2_sign_chi_iff_grh_chi, v0.14), the converse by the ζ route over the χ-configuration with its own local count. The one clause now has two compiled instances, ζ and primitive χ ≠ 1, each equivalent to the location of its own zeros; neither is proved. A companion census, Paths to the Critical Line, catalogues the field's completing and non-completing paths in relation, including the sign-layer survey (§ANNEX B) and two machine-checked negative results.

CONTENTS. A_Place_to_Stand.md — the full manuscript (v5.10.2). Six companion papers: Exhaustive_Enumeration, Which_Structure_Confines, Spectral_Inertness, Third_Identity_Element, Silence_of_Foundations, Seven_Mechanism_Classes. ONE_PAGE_PROOF.md — the condensed proof chain. FORMATION_ARCHITECTURE.html, PAPER_DEPENDENCIES.svg — visualization assets. ERRATA.md — the standing correction record.

PAIRED DEPOSITS. SIDE-kernel v1.5, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21520474 (all versions: 10.5281/zenodo.19674312). SIDE-lv-conservation v0.10.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21539068 (all versions: 10.5281/zenodo.21433177). Two Mathlib contributions from this work are merged: PR #36881 (tendsto_mul_logDeriv_simple_zero) and PR #36865 (analyticOrderAt_eq_one_of_zero_deriv_ne_zero).

VERSION. v5.7–v5.8 (July 2026): the fulcrum reframe (§27.3 to five registers with ancestry) and h1 completed at the witness, with the C₄ strengthening story told in full. v1.1.2 / manuscript v5.10.2 (July 2026): the re-articulation release — the monograph's narrative re-articulated end to end in five meaning-preserving passes (spine orientation, seam bridges, canonical homes for repeated stories, voice separation, currency); §25.8 and §25.1 currency to kernel v1.5; §27.3 currency to lv v0.10.0 (the proved finite-set conjunct); step (9) recast into its identity/sign sentences with step (10) carrying the explicit clause tag; the Third_Identity element-level convention caveat; ERRATA entry E-2026-07-23-1 (§18.2 label correction). No mathematical claim changed in any of these releases; the open clause stands exactly as named.

CURRENCY. This record is the citable deposit at manuscript v5.10.2. The live line stands ahead of it at v5.18 and is not deposited; counts and kernel figures here are frozen at the deposit. The clause h2 stays open, and the Riemann Hypothesis is not proved here. h2_sign is equivalent to Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis, both directions compiled (h2_sign_iff_rh, SIDE-explicit-formula).

18.description:
SIDE-kernel: the machine-verified architecture of the SIDE programme's route terminals. Its Route 3 premise is RH restated (E-2026-09-25-1); the programme's standing reduction is Weil positivity on classK, equivalent to RH on the kernel's zero configuration, compiled both ways in SIDE-explicit-formula v0.1. Li's criterion is compiled over Mathlib's zeros as a two-way equivalence in the programme's kernel (li_nonneg_iff_rh, v0.9), its converse vendored from nicholasbulka/li-criterion-rh-equivalence-lean at 35df682f under Apache 2.0; equivalently, RH is the nonnegativity of the Bombieri–Lagarias arithmetic limits (arith_limit_nonneg_iff_rh). Weil positivity on classK, Li positivity and arithmetic-limit positivity are compiled as equivalent faces of the one open clause. The criterion for primitive χ is composed: Weil positivity on classK for χ ⟺ GRH_chi, both directions compiled (h2_sign_chi_iff_grh_chi, v0.14), the converse by the ζ route over the χ-configuration with its own local count. The one clause now has two compiled instances, ζ and primitive χ ≠ 1, each equivalent to the location of its own zeros; neither is proved.

THE PROGRAMME. The SIDE method — Symmetry, Independence, Determination, Exhaustiveness — treats the completed zeta function xi(s) as a determined system: a finite, parameter-free specification whose possible zero-producing mechanisms can be enumerated and excluded class by class. The proof enumerates the seven mechanism classes from which an off-line zero would have to arise (exhaustive via Ostrowski's classification of the places of Q), proves the system sealed against external structural force (Conservation of Spectra, from Tate's thesis), and excludes each class. The companion manuscript, A Place To Stand (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19675355), carries the mathematics; this kernel compiles the argument's logical architecture under the named premise so the skeleton can be verified mechanically rather than on trust.

WHAT THE KERNEL CONTAINS. The seven-class catalogue and its exhaustiveness structure; the seven Voice files carrying the per-class exclusion algebra; the product-formula conservation chain (prime, integer, and rational levels); the perpendicular-crossing chain; the formation count; and three independent route terminals: structural_exhaustiveness_proved (the catalogue conjunction), SpectralCannonFull.spectral_cannon (the derivative of xi purely imaginary on the critical line), and ConservationBridge.riemann_hypothesis (the compiled implication from ConservationHypothesis, which the kernel's own balance_theorem shows is RH restated — E-2026-09-25-1). The architecture states exactly what it takes as input and machine-checks everything around it.

HOW TO CHECK. Run lake build at the pinned commit 0e5233f (tag v1.5), then #print axioms at the named terminals. All route terminals report {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} — Lean core only, zero custom axioms, zero sorry, no native_decide. Verification claims are made by named theorem at pinned public commits, never by file or theorem counts. Where a compiled statement models rather than derives an analytic fact, the source docstring says so at the site, and the manuscript's Section 25.8 concordance grades every terminal.

THIS VERSION. v1.5 aligns the kernel source with the manuscript's Route-1 account: the C6 codimension count is now derived from an explicit constraint structure rather than assigned by a conditional literal; the C7 Hadamard stand-in discloses at every site that its analytic content is manuscript-resident; and one vacuously-hypothesized theorem was retired and renamed to what it actually proves (offLine_of_codim_two). No mathematical claim changed — the refinement makes the compiled content and its named inputs fully legible to an outside reader.

Repository: github.com/psinary-sketch/SIDE-kernel. Federation: companion SIDE-* repositories carry the abstract exclusion engine and the breadth results.

CURRENCY. This record is the citable deposit at SIDE-kernel v1.5 = 0e5233f. The live kernel line names SIDE-explicit-formula beside it and is not deposited. Where the text above says "the proof", it names the argument under the named premise, which stays open.
